final_sql:
SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'

SELECT frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation'
ORDER BY frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT schools.MailStreet
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T2.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1."FRPM Count (K-12)" = (
    SELECT MAX("FRPM Count (K-12)")
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded'

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) > 0.3
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0;

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(satscores.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / satscores.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT schools.School,
       schools.NCESSchool,
       frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.dname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T1.dname
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank,
    sc.CharterNum,
    s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools AS s 
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds 
WHERE s.County = 'Fresno' 
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' 
  AND t.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' 
  AND "Low Grade" = '9' 
  AND "High Grade" = '12';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
  AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
  AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700;

SELECT sname
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T3.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T3.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Monterey'
  AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800;

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite, sc.Phone
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) > '1991'
   OR strftime('%Y', sc.ClosedDate) < '2000'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
GROUP BY T2.CDSCode
HAVING T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
    SELECT AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm AS T1
    INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
    WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS TotalEnrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY TotalEnrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)"
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Website
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s."AdmEmail1"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Admin1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Admin2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Admin3
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode = (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.cname = 'Los Angeles'
  AND st.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' 
  AND T1.cname = 'Fresno'

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sa.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SchoolName
FROM (
    SELECT sc.School AS SchoolName,
           sc.Virtual AS Virtual,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.County ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sa
    JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sa.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE Virtual = 'F' AND rnk <= 5;

SELECT schools.EILName
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.City
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 = (
    SELECT MAX(NumGE1500)
    FROM satscores
);

SELECT T2.sname, T2.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = 31
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT County, School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
      SELECT County
      FROM schools
      WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
      GROUP BY County
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT s.sname AS School_Name, sc.MailStreet AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s.MailStreet, t.sname
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores T1 
JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite >= 1500 
  AND T2.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT SUM(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.MailCity = 'Fresno'

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName3 = 'Atoian');

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Colusa' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
  SUM(CASE WHEN County = 'Humboldt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt');

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailState = 'CA' 
  AND StatusType = 'Active' 
  AND City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT sch.Phone, sch.Ext
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools sch ON st.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE st.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY st.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE City = 'Hickman' AND Charter = 1 AND DOC = 52

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = '0'
  AND T1.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] * 100.0 / T1.[Enrollment (K-12)] < 0.18;

SELECT School,
       City,
       AdmFName1 || ' ' || AdmLName1 AS Administrator1,
       AdmFName2 || ' ' || AdmLName2 AS Administrator2,
       AdmFName3 || ' ' || AdmLName3 AS Administrator3
FROM schools
WHERE Charter = '1'
  AND CharterNum = '00D2';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode)
FROM schools
WHERE OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '12/31/2005'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_closures
FROM schools
WHERE DOCType = 'Community College District'
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) = '1989'
  AND City = 'San Francisco';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT NCESDist FROM schools WHERE SOC = 31;

SELECT COUNT(StatusType)
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alpine'
  AND StatusType IN ('Active', 'Closed')
  AND (SOCType = 'District Community Day School' OR DOCType = 'District Community Day School');
SELECT District FROM schools WHERE Magnet = 0 AND City = 'Fresno'

SELECT T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.City = 'Fremont'
  AND T1.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND T2.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'

SELECT T2.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040'
  AND T1.EdOpsName LIKE '%Youth Authority School%';

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
WHERE EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'
  AND NCESDist = '0613360';

SELECT schools.EILName AS `Educational Level Name`, schools.School AS `School Name`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`County Code` = '37';

SELECT schools.City
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2'
  AND frpm.`Low Grade` = '9'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` = '12'
  AND frpm.`County Name` = 'Merced'
  AND schools.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT s.School,
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-9'
  AND s.County = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'F'
  AND County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School, T1.Latitude, T2.`School Type`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.City, T2.`Low Grade`, T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY T1.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(*)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT Fname, District
FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools
)
WHERE Fname IS NOT NULL
  AND Fname IN (
      SELECT Fname
      FROM (
          SELECT AdmFName1 AS Fname FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT AdmFName2 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
          UNION ALL
          SELECT AdmFName3 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
      )
      GROUP BY Fname
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 2
  );

SELECT f."District Code",
       f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmLName1 AS "Administrator Last Name",
       District,
       County,
       School
FROM schools
WHERE CharterNum = '40';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1, T2.AdmEmail2, T2.AdmEmail3
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND T2.City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND T2.DOC = 54
  AND T2.SOC = 62
  AND T2.OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DisplayName, Reputation
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01';

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM users 
WHERE Views > 10 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CreationDate) AS INTEGER) > 2013;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts);

SELECT SUM(p.CommentCount) AS TotalComments
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie');

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts p 
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id 
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' 
  AND p.ParentId IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.Age > 65 AND posts.Score >= 20;

SELECT u.Location
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON posts.Id = tags.ExcerptPostId
WHERE tags.Count = (SELECT MAX(Count) FROM tags);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(badges.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(users.DisplayName) AS average_badges
FROM users
LEFT JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE users.Views > 200;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN p.Id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = 58 AND CreationDate = '2010-07-19'

SELECT CreationDate
FROM votes
GROUP BY CreationDate
ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Revival';

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
JOIN comments ON posts.Id = comments.PostId
WHERE comments.Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM comments)

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 3025
  AND c.CreationDate = '2014-04-23 20:29:39.0';

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT CASE
           WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'not well-finished'
           ELSE 'well-finished'
       END AS status
FROM posts p
WHERE p.Id = (
    SELECT c.PostId
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.UserId = 23853
      AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'
);

SELECT u.Reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Id = 65041;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM posts 
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id 
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.Id = 6347;

SELECT COUNT(v.Id) AS NumberOfVotes
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data visualization%';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'DatEpicCoderGuyWhoPrograms';
SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = '24') AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE UserId = '24') AS posts_to_votes_ratio;
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'SilentGhost';

SELECT c.Text

WITH Consumption2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotal
    FROM Consumption2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestConsumers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumption,
           COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers
    FROM Consumption2013 AS t
    JOIN MinConsumption AS m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           TotalConsumption / NumCustomers AS AvgConsumption
    FROM LowestConsumers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05' AND status = 'A'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT CAST(t.balance AS REAL) AS b
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT CAST(t.balance AS REAL) AS b
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
)
SELECT (balance_end.b - balance_start.b) * 100.0 / balance_start.b AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.Consumption) / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)

        ) * 100.0
        / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage_increase
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM pct
WHERE percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM pct)

JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.A11 AS avg_salary
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
lowest_salary AS (
    SELECT MIN(avg_salary) AS low_sal
    FROM female_clients
),
oldest_female AS (
    SELECT fc.client_id, fc.avg_salary
    FROM female_clients fc
    WHERE fc.avg_salary = (SELECT low_sal FROM lowest_salary)
      AND fc.birth_date = (
          SELECT MAX(fc2.birth_date)
          FROM female_clients fc2
          WHERE fc2.avg_salary = (SELECT low_sal FROM lowest_salary)
      )
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(fc3.avg_salary) FROM female_clients fc3) - o.avg_salary AS gap
FROM oldest_female o
JOIN disp dp ON o.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id;

JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id

WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools
      WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName3) <> ''
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS occurrences
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY first_name
),
top_two AS (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM name_counts
    ORDER BY occurrences DESC, first_name
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.first_name, n.occurrences, a.District
FROM admin_names a
JOIN top_two t    ON t.first_name = a.first_name
JOIN name_counts n ON n.first_name = a.first_name
ORDER BY n.occurrences DESC, a.first_name, a.District;

WITH customer_annual AS (
    -- Total consumption over 2013 for each CZK-paying customer, along with segment
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    -- Minimum annual consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customers (handles ties) having the lowest consumption in their segment
    SELECT ca.Segment, ca.total_consumption
    FROM customer_annual ca
    JOIN lowest_per_segment lps
      ON ca.Segment = lps.Segment
     AND ca.total_consumption = lps.min_consumption
),
segment_averages AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest consumers / their count
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM segment_averages;

WITH yearly AS (
    -- Total consumption per segment per year, for EUR customers only
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS yr,          -- first 4 chars of Date = year
        SUM(ym.Consumption)   AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
pct AS (
    -- Percentage change per the hint: (2013 - 2012) / 2013 * 100
    SELECT
        Segment,
        ( MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN total_consumption END)
        ) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption END), 0)
          AS pct_increase
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_pct_increase,
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC  LIMIT 1) AS lowest_pct_increase;

    pa.agility,
    pa.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT DISTINCT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_games
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
  AND League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_team_score
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY p.weight DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    League.name,
    COUNT(Match.id) AS num_games
FROM League
JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (
    SELECT MAX(away_team_goal)
    FROM Match
);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (
    SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
    FROM Player_Attributes
);

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE 
            WHEN P.height < 180 AND PA.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 
          END) * 100.0 / COUNT(PA.id) AS percentage
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        WHEN AVG(A13) > AVG(A12) THEN '1996'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS year_with_higher_unemployment
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d     ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c   ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
ORDER BY c.birth_date DESC,
         di.A11 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND a.account_id IN (
      SELECT l.account_id
      FROM loan l
      WHERE l.status = 'A'                 -- approved loan
        AND l.date LIKE '1997%'            -- loan date in 1997
        AND l.amount = (
            SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
            FROM loan l2
            WHERE l2.status = 'A'
              AND l2.date LIKE '1997%'
        )
  );

SELECT l.account_id,
       l.amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) AS num_female_customers
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND district.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT account_id, MIN(date) AS earliest_trading_date
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING MIN(date) BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT a.date AS account_open_date
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840
  AND t.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp    d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN disp  d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id  = l.account_id
WHERE l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT DISTINCT disp.disp_id
FROM disp
JOIN trans ON disp.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 5100
  AND trans.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN loan ON disp.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832
  AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_client_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND d.A4 = (
      SELECT MAX(A4)
      FROM district
      WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  );

SELECT 
    ((t_later.balance - t_earlier.balance) * 100.0 / t_earlier.balance) AS increase_rate
FROM trans t_earlier
JOIN trans t_later 
     ON t_earlier.account_id = t_later.account_id
WHERE t_earlier.date = '1993-03-22'      -- Date B (earlier)
  AND t_later.date   = '1998-12-27'      -- Date A (later)
  AND t_earlier.account_id = (
        -- Account of the client whose loan was approved first on 1993/7/5
        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM loan l
        JOIN disp  d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
        JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
        WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
        ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC
        LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT district.A2 AS district_name, district.A3 AS region
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT 
    l.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A3, d.A11
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT
    d.district_id,
    ROUND(((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100, 2) AS unemployment_rate_increment_pct
FROM loan l
JOIN account a  ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c   ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS decin_percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp d2 ON c.client_id = d2.client_id
JOIN account a ON d2.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, t.amount AS withdrawal_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
ORDER BY t.amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM disp dp
        JOIN card c 
            ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
        WHERE dp.account_id = a.account_id
  );

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(amount)
      FROM loan
      WHERE status IN ('C', 'D')
  );

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id

       d.A2          AS district_name,
       d.A13         AS unemployment_rate_1996

WHERE d.A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13)

FROM account a
WHERE a.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    ORDER BY d.A16 DESC

);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

FROM loan AS l
INNER JOIN account AS a
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id

FROM client

      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC

FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT DISTINCT

FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id

FROM "order" o

FROM account a

SELECT AVG(monthly_totals.monthly_amount) AS avg_credit_card_amount_per_month
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
           SUM(amount) AS monthly_amount
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'          -- credit card withdrawal
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'       -- restrict to year 2021
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)          -- total per month
) AS monthly_totals;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp  d ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'            -- credit card withdrawal
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'         -- transactions in 1998
  AND t.amount < (                            -- amount below the average
        SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
        FROM trans t2
        WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
          AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1998'
      );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts

FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id),
        2
    ) AS pct_female
FROM client c
JOIN disp d      ON d.client_id   = c.client_id
JOIN account a   ON a.account_id  = d.account_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    ( SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount END)
    ) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
        WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
          AND c.gender = 'M'
      );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS credit_card_withdrawals_after_1995
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND date > 951231;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END)
    -
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_dispositions
FROM disp
WHERE account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
  AND type IN ('OWNER', 'DISPONENT');

SELECT
    k_symbol           AS aim,              -- purpose of the payment
    COUNT(*)           AS times_requested,  -- how often the statement was released
    SUM(amount)        AS total_debited
FROM trans
WHERE account_id = 3
  AND type = 'VYDAJ'                     -- 'VYDAJ' = debit (withdrawal) in this dataset
GROUP BY k_symbol
HAVING SUM(amount) = 3539;

SELECT strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE disp.account_id = 130

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT
    cl.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount                                    AS loan_amount,
    l.payments                                  AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration                                  AS duration_months,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished, no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished, loan NOT paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Contract running, OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Contract running, client in debt'
    END                                         AS status_description,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)                  AS paid_so_far,
    l.amount - COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)       AS remaining_debt
FROM client cl
JOIN disp     d ON d.client_id  = cl.client_id
JOIN account  a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN loan     l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t
       ON t.account_id = a.account_id
      AND t.k_symbol   = 'UVER'          -- loan-payment transactions
WHERE cl.client_id = 992
  AND l.status IN ('B', 'D')              -- only loans where the client is in debt
GROUP BY
    cl.client_id, l.loan_id, l.amount,
    l.payments, l.duration, l.status;

SELECT t.balance AS sum_after_trans_851,

FROM trans t
JOIN disp d   ON d.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
WHERE t.trans_id = 851

SELECT c.type
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998';

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date
FROM client c

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory.GLU
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Description) = '1991'
  AND Laboratory.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.WBC <= 3.5
   OR l.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY p.SEX ASC, p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.ID, 
    p.Diagnosis, 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT 
    p.ID, 
    p.SEX, 
    p.Birthday, 
    p.Admission, 
    l.RBC
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
  AND (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Laboratory.HGB < 10;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.HGB > 10
  AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID, T1.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) > 2;

SELECT AVG(HCT) AS average_hct_below_normal
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date LIKE '1991%'
  AND HCT < 29;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_higher_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    P.ID, 
    P.SEX, 
    P.Birthday, 
    P.Description
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', L.Date) AS INTEGER) = 1984
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 50
  AND L.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS percentage
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) > 1992
  AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*)

  AND Laboratory.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS num_patients

  AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients

WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5
  AND T2.WBC < 9.0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID

  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients

JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY T2.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGA > 80
  AND Laboratory.IGA < 500
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGM <= 40 OR L.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY P.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(P.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient

WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(SUBSTR(DATE('now'), 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(SUBSTR(Patient.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 1985
  AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RF < 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT E.ID

    )

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RNP IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e

  AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT P.ID
FROM Patient P

LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E

    ON E.ID = L.ID

  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1

LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)

SELECT DISTINCT Diagnosis

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

LIMIT 3;

SELECT MIN(T2.`First Date`)

    SELECT T1.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS T1
    WHERE T1.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY T1.LDH DESC

FROM Laboratory AS T1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP >= 300 AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis

FROM Patient P

  AND L.TP < 8.5;

  AND l.ALB > 3.5
  AND l.ALB < 5.5

FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
  AND E."aCL IgA" = (
      SELECT MAX("aCL IgA")

  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients

WHERE l.`T-CHO` < 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients

  AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT P.Diagnosis

WHERE P.ID = (

    ORDER BY L.TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID

JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients

SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID

  AND L.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT T2.PLT
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'

  AND T2.PLT < 400;

SELECT AVG(L.PT) AS average_prothrombin_time

JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

WHERE T2.Thrombosis IN (1, 2)

SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_type) AS bond_count

ORDER BY bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT AVG(element = 'o')
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
       FROM bond b
       JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
      WHERE m.label = '+'
        AND b.bond_type = '-') * 1.0
    /
    (SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
       FROM atom a
       JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
      WHERE m.label = '+') AS average_single_bonded;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'na'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT

FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_carcinogenic

  AND label = '+';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT m.label

WHERE a.element = 'h'
GROUP BY m.label

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type

WHERE atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
       a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
       a2.element AS atom2_element

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.element) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.bond_type

JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE (T1.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (T1.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8');

SELECT DISTINCT label

WHERE label NOT IN (
    SELECT m.label
    FROM molecule m

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom

WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a2.atom_id

JOIN connected c  ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id

WHERE a1.molecule_id = 'TR181';

    SUM(CASE
            WHEN molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id

        END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id) AS percentage

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom_1,

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

  AND b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT bond_id
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id2 = (
    SELECT atom_id2
    FROM connected
    WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2'
);

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(bond_id), 
        5
    ) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008';

SELECT atom.element, molecule.label

HAVING COUNT(b.bond_type) = (SELECT MAX(cnt)
                             FROM   (SELECT COUNT(bond_type) AS cnt
                                     FROM   bond
                                     WHERE  molecule_id = 'TR010'
                                     GROUP  BY bond_type) AS counts);

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id

WITH pairs AS (
    -- one row per bond, with its (unordered) pair of atom elements
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS el1,
           CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS el2
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- number of bonds for each element combination
    SELECT el1, el2, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS n_bonds
    FROM pairs
    GROUP BY el1, el2
)
SELECT el1 || '-' || el2 AS most_common_element_combination,
       ROUND(100.0 * n_bonds / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond), 2) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts
ORDER BY n_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, t.total_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN -annual_avg END) AS SME_minus_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN -annual_avg END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN -annual_avg END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM avgs;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
            / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date,1,4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
biggest AS (
    SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, Percentage FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage ASC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM biggest
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM lowest;

SELECT
  ((SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = t.account_id
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1)
   -
   (SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = t.account_id
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1)
  ) * 100.0
  /
  (SELECT balance
   FROM trans
   WHERE account_id = t.account_id
     AND date = '1993-03-22'
   ORDER BY trans_id DESC
   LIMIT 1) AS increase_rate
FROM (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    AND status = 'A'
  ORDER BY loan_id
  LIMIT 1
) t;

SELECT SUM(T1.cost) / COUNT(T3.link_to_event)
FROM expense AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id

WHERE T2.category = 'Parking'

HAVING SUM(T3.cost) / COUNT(T1.event_id) < (
    SELECT SUM(T4.cost) / COUNT(T6.event_id)
    FROM expense AS T4
    JOIN budget AS T5 ON T4.link_to_budget = T5.budget_id
    JOIN event AS T6 ON T5.link_to_event = T6.event_id

)

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg, c.CustomerID AS cid, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT seg, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY seg
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.seg, CAST(SUM(t.total_cons) AS REAL) / COUNT(t.cid) AS avg_cons
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON m.seg = t.seg AND m.min_cons = t.total_cons
    GROUP BY t.seg
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS "SME - LAM",
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS "LAM - KAM",
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') AS "KAM - SME";

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013 AS PercentageIncrease
    FROM seg
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT Segment, PercentageIncrease FROM pct ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT Segment, PercentageIncrease FROM pct ORDER BY PercentageIncrease ASC LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a 
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' 
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id);
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A11 > 6000 AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT D.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - DI.A11 AS gap
FROM client C
JOIN district DI ON C.district_id = DI.district_id
JOIN disp D ON C.client_id = D.client_id
WHERE C.gender = 'F'
  AND C.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND DI.A11 = (SELECT MIN(DI2.A11)
                FROM client C2
                JOIN district DI2 ON C2.district_id = DI2.district_id
                WHERE C2.gender = 'F'
                  AND C2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'));

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT DISTINCT client.client_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'

  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (

      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'
  );

JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

JOIN account a ON a.account_id = disp.account_id

FROM account AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id

SELECT a.date

SELECT account.district_id FROM account JOIN loan ON loan.account_id = account.account_id WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25' AND loan.status = 'A';

WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21'

FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id

    FROM loan l

JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id

SELECT disp.disp_id
FROM disp
JOIN trans ON disp.account_id = trans.account_id

SELECT COUNT(*)

WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03';
SELECT account.account_id FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague' ORDER BY account.date LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.client_id) 
FROM client AS T1 
WHERE T1.district_id = (
    SELECT T2.district_id 
    FROM district AS T2 
    WHERE T2.A3 = 'south Bohemia' 
    ORDER BY T2.A4 DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'A' AND date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
b1 AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
    LIMIT 1
),
b2 AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (b2.balance - b1.balance) * 100.0 / b1.balance
FROM b1, b2;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2, d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT account.account_id, district.A2, district.A3
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id

SELECT loan.loan_id, district.A3, district.A11
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id

SELECT d.A2, d.A3, ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) = '1993' OR SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 2) = '93';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

FROM client
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY district.A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') AS Result
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory);
SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY P.SEX

SELECT T1.ID, T1."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) / COUNT(T1.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`T-CHO` >= 250
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG > 300

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG >= 200 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y',T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 50

SELECT DISTINCT t1.ID
FROM Patient AS t1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t1.Admission = '-' AND t2.CPK < 250;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU >= 180 AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250;
SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991' AND T2.GLU < 180

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.WBC <= 3.5 OR T2.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY T1.SEX, T1.Birthday

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis, T1.ID, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Admission FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND (strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) >= 50 AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.HGB < 10

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.HGB > 10 AND l.HGB < 17
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.HCT >= 52 GROUP BY T1.ID HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) > 2
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date LIKE '1991%' AND HCT < 29
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Laboratory;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1984' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 50 AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.PT >= 14 AND T2.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) > 55

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) > 1992
  AND T2.PT < 14;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.APTT < 45;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.WBC > 3.5 AND T2.WBC < 9.0 AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0 AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000 AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500 ORDER BY T2.IGA DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGA > 80 AND T2.IGA < 500 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGM <= 40 OR T2.IGM >= 400 GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.KCT = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday >= '1985-01-01' AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < CAST(SUBSTR('now', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 60 AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RF < 20);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND T3.Thrombosis = '0'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.C3 > 35 AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'P'
SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.HCT <= 29 OR T1.HCT >= 52 GROUP BY T2.ID ORDER BY MAX(T2.`aCL IgA`) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 1 AND T3.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RNP IN ('-', '+-') AND Patient.Admission = '+'
SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-') ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0') ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT DISTINCT t1.ID FROM Examination AS t1 JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID WHERE t1."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND t2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

FROM Patient p

JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-','+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0') ORDER BY T1.`First Date` ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SSB IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T1.Admission = '+'

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GOT >= 60
SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT < 60 ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT T1.`First Date` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(T1.Date) FROM Laboratory AS T1 WHERE T1.LDH >= 500 AND T1.ID IN (SELECT T2.ID FROM Patient AS T2 WHERE T2."First Date" = (SELECT MAX("First Date") FROM Patient))
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALP >= 300 AND T1.Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.ALP < 300

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT E."aCL IgG", E."aCL IgM", E."aCL IgA"
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T3."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT T1.ANA FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` < 2.0 ORDER BY T2.`T-BIL` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.`T-CHO` >= 250 AND T3.`KCT` = '-'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2."T-CHO" < 250 AND T3."ANA Pattern" = 'P'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID WHERE l.TG < 200 AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 0 AND T3.CPK < 250
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CPK < 250 AND (T3.KCT = '+' OR T3.RVVT = '+' OR T3.LAC = '+')
SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU > 180
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GLU < 180 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '+' AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (L.RBC <= 3.5 OR L.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.PLT > 100 AND T2.PLT < 400 AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.PLT FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND T1.PLT > 100 AND T1.PLT < 400
SELECT AVG(T.PT) FROM Laboratory AS T JOIN Patient AS P ON T.ID = P.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND T.PT < 14

FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT AVG(element = 'o')

JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '='
