WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS Total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mincons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Total) AS MinTotal
    FROM czk2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT z.Segment AS Segment, SUM(z.Total) AS SumTotal, COUNT(*) AS NumCust
    FROM czk2013 z
    JOIN mincons m ON m.Segment = z.Segment AND m.MinTotal = z.Total
    GROUP BY z.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SumTotal * 1.0 / NumCust AS AvgConsumption
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
      (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
      (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
      (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) > COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END)
         THEN 'In-patient'
         ELSE 'Outpatient'
       END AS more_common,
       (COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END)) * 100.0
         / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 0) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'

               (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
                - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
                / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
        FROM yearmonth ym
        JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
        WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
          AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
        GROUP BY c.Segment
    ) t
)
WHERE percentage = max_pct OR percentage = min_pct

   / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate

    SELECT d.account_id

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT p.Segment, SUM(p.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN min_per_segment m ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2013
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (Cons2013 - Cons2012) * 100.0 / Cons2013 AS PctChange
  FROM totals
),
biggest AS (
  SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY PctChange DESC LIMIT 1
),
lowest AS (
  SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY PctChange ASC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT Segment FROM biggest
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment FROM lowest;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID

LIMIT 1;

SELECT ProductID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-23' AND Time = '21:20:00'

SELECT T1.Date, T1.Consumption
FROM yearmonth AS T1
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T2.Date = '2012-08-24'
  AND ROUND(CAST(T2.Price AS REAL), 2) = 124.05
  AND (T1.Date LIKE '2012-01%' OR T1.Date LIKE '201201%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE transactions_1k.Date = '2012-08-26' AND transactions_1k.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00' AND gasstations.Country = 'CZE'
SELECT T1.Currency FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Date LIKE '%201306%' AND T2.Consumption = 214582.17
SELECT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE t.CardID = 667467
SELECT gasstations.Country FROM transactions_1k JOIN gasstations ON transactions_1k.GasStationID = gasstations.GasStationID WHERE transactions_1k.Date = '2012-08-24' AND transactions_1k.Price = 548.4

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID)
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
)
SELECT GasStationID FROM transactions_1k GROUP BY GasStationID ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'SVK';
SELECT SUM(Price) AS total_spent, SUM(CASE WHEN Date = '201201' THEN Price ELSE 0 END) AS spent_january_2012 FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508

SELECT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Description
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH seg_pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, pct_increase
FROM seg_pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM seg_pct)
   OR pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM seg_pct);

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_consumption m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 1) AS BiggestIncrease,
  (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 1) AS LowestIncrease;

    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match

    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM im
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM im

    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM im
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM im

    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM im

    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM im

JOIN disp T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN client T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id
JOIN district T2 ON T4.district_id = T2.district_id

      SELECT MIN(D.A11)
      FROM client C
      JOIN district D ON C.district_id = D.district_id
      WHERE C.gender = 'F'
        AND C.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')

FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id

SELECT account_id
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague'

LIMIT 1;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE LOWER(A3) = 'south bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT (
  (SELECT t.balance FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = d.account_id AND t.date = '1998-12-27' ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1)
  - (SELECT t.balance FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = d.account_id AND t.date = '1993-03-22' ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1)
) * 100.0 /
  (SELECT t.balance FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = d.account_id AND t.date = '1993-03-22' ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS increase_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05' AND l.status IN ('A', 'C')
ORDER BY l.loan_id
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan;
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN account_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS region
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE (a.date LIKE '1993%' OR a.date LIKE '93%')
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND (
        CAST(substr(a.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000
     OR CAST(substr(a.date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) + 1900 BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000
     OR substr(a.date, 1, 2) = '00'
      );

FROM loan l

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

FROM account a

SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avgs AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment AS Segment, SUM(ct.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM cust_totals AS ct
    JOIN min_totals AS mt ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total = mt.min_total
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM'),
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM'),
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME');

WITH sums AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct
    FROM sums
)
SELECT Segment, pct
FROM pct
WHERE pct = (SELECT MAX(pct) FROM pct)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, pct
FROM pct
WHERE pct = (SELECT MIN(pct) FROM pct);

JOIN hero_power ON hero_power.hero_id = superhero.id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Intelligence';
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero AS s JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
INNER JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) > COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END),
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F';
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT Patient.Diagnosis, Laboratory.Date FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.ID = '30609'
SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.ID = '163109'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH > 500
SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;
SELECT p.* FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1937' AND l.`T-CHO` >= 250
SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis FROM Laboratory AS L JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.ALB < 3.5

SELECT AVG(e."aCL IgG") FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE p.Admission = '+' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Patient.Description) = '1997' AND Patient.Admission = '-'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) FROM Patient AS p ORDER BY CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE e.`Examination Date` LIKE '1997%' AND e.Thrombosis = '1' AND p.SEX = 'F';
SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200;

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.Birthday = (
      SELECT MAX(p2.Birthday)
      FROM Patient p2
      WHERE p2.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE Symptoms IS NOT NULL)
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) * 1.0 / 12 AS average_male_patients_per_month
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND Patient.SEX = 'M';

SELECT l.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', p.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS p
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient AS p 
JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) < '18' 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

       e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID

SELECT P.SEX FROM Patient AS P WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS' ORDER BY P.'First Date' ASC LIMIT 1;

FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID

FROM Patient p

FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID

FROM Laboratory AS L
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'

  AND L.ALB < 4;

FROM Patient AS p

      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + (AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`)) * 0.2
      FROM Examination

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory lab ON p.ID = lab.ID WHERE p.Admission = '-' AND lab.Date LIKE '1991-10%' AND lab.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID

FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID

FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

LIMIT 1

JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1982'
  AND Laboratory.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT Patient.SEX AS SEX, Laboratory.UA AS UA
    FROM Patient
    JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
    WHERE Laboratory.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS L2
        WHERE L2.ID = Laboratory.ID
    )
) AS T
WHERE (T.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
   OR (T.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5)

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS lab ON lab.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND lab.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT (SUM(p.SEX = 'M') > SUM(p.SEX = 'F'))

JOIN Patient AS p ON lab.ID = p.ID

FROM Patient

FROM Patient

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Admission
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.Admission = '-' AND l.HGB < 10

SELECT p.ID,
       CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID, p.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(l.ID) > 2;
SELECT AVG(Laboratory.HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE Laboratory.Date LIKE '1991%' AND Laboratory.HCT < 29

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           y.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) AS seg_total,
           COUNT(*) AS seg_count
    FROM cust_totals AS ct
    JOIN seg_min AS sm
      ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           CAST(seg_total AS REAL) / seg_count AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment AS Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        consumption_2012,
        consumption_2013,
        ROUND((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(consumption_2013, 0), 2) AS pct_increase
    FROM pct
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM ranked ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS segment_with_biggest_increase,
    (SELECT pct_increase FROM ranked ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_pct_increase,
    (SELECT Segment FROM ranked ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS segment_with_lowest_increase,
    (SELECT pct_increase FROM ranked ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_pct_increase;

WITH player_match AS (
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_2 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_3 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_4 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_5 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_6 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_7 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_8 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_9 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_10 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.home_player_11 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_1 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_2 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_3 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_4 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_5 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL

    SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_8 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_9 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_10 FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.country_id, m.away_player_11 FROM Match m
)
SELECT c.name AS country_name,
       AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
FROM player_match pm
JOIN Country c ON c.id = pm.country_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pm.player_api_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY avg_weight DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(p.height) AS avg_height
FROM (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE pa.crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left';
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year FROM district

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client INNER JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id AS account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);

SELECT d.account_id
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district t ON t.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(c2.birth_date) FROM client c2)
  AND t.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS owner_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date LIKE '1997%'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C')
  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
        FROM loan l2
        WHERE l2.date LIKE '1997%'
          AND l2.status IN ('A', 'C')
      )
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
        FROM loan AS l2
        JOIN account AS a2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
        WHERE l2.duration > 12
          AND strftime('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id

JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id

SELECT account_id
FROM account

      FROM account
      WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE account.date < '1997-01-01'

SELECT disp.client_id

WHERE card.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT A.date

SELECT d.district_id

SELECT MAX(t.amount)

JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender

JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id

    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996';

JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC, a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_client_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT
    ((SELECT t.balance
      FROM trans t
      WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id
        AND t.date = '1998-12-27')
     -
     (SELECT t.balance
      FROM trans t
      WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id
        AND t.date = '1993-03-22'))
    * 100.0
    /
    (SELECT t.balance
     FROM trans t
     WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id
       AND t.date = '1993-03-22') AS increase_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
ORDER BY l.date, l.loan_id
LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS pct_paid_no_issue FROM loan

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, c.client_id AS account_holder
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'

    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, c.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, SUM(z.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN seg_min m ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment AS Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment

WITH alameda_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE County = 'Alameda'
),
rates AS (
    SELECT f.`CDSCode`,
           f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0) AS eligible_free_rate
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN alameda_schools s ON f.`CDSCode` = s.CDSCode
)
SELECT MAX(eligible_free_rate) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM rates;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND (s.District = 'Fresno County Office of Education' OR s.County = 'Fresno');

WITH top_school AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM frpm
  ORDER BY `FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.CDSCode;

WITH direct_charter AS (
    SELECT CDSCode
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
      AND `Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
)
SELECT s.Phone
FROM direct_charter dc
JOIN schools s ON dc.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

WITH avg_math AS (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN avg_math am ON s.CDSCode = am.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
  AND am.avg_math_score > 400;

WITH high_takers AS (
    SELECT cds, sname
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumTstTakr > 500
)
SELECT t.sname
FROM high_takers t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1;

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school ts ON s.CDSCode = ts.cds;

SELECT s.cds, s.NumTstTakr
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`) FROM frpm);

WITH high_math AS (
    SELECT cds AS CDS_Code
    FROM satscores
    WHERE AvgScrMath > 560
),
charter_funding AS (
    SELECT s.FundingType
    FROM high_math h
    JOIN schools s ON h.CDS_Code = s.CDSCode
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS Directly_Funded_School_Count
FROM charter_funding
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded';

WITH TotalEnrollment AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS TotalEnrollment
    FROM frpm
)
SELECT CDSCode
FROM TotalEnrollment
WHERE TotalEnrollment > 500;

WITH excellent_schools AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumTstTakr > 0
      AND NumGE1500 * 1.0 / NumTstTakr > 0.3
)
SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`, 0)) AS highest_eligible_free_rate_ages_5_17
FROM excellent_schools e
JOIN schools sc ON e.cds = sc.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode;

WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT cds,
           NumGE1500 * 1.0 / NULLIF(NumTstTakr, 0) AS excellence_rate
    FROM satscores
    WHERE rtype = 'S' AND NumTstTakr > 0
    ORDER BY excellence_rate DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN top3 t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds;

WITH district_avg AS (

    FROM satscores sat
    JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
    GROUP BY s.District
)
SELECT District
FROM district_avg
ORDER BY avg_reading DESC

WITH merged_alameda AS (
    SELECT schools.CDSCode
    FROM schools
    WHERE schools.County = 'Alameda'
      AND schools.StatusType = 'Merged'

sat_counts AS (
    SELECT satscores.cds, satscores.NumTstTakr
    FROM satscores
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM merged_alameda

WHERE sat_counts.NumTstTakr < 100;

WITH avg_scores AS (
    SELECT cds, sname, AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds, sname
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT a.sname,
           a.avg_writing_score,
           sc.CharterNum,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_writing_score DESC) AS writing_rank
    FROM avg_scores a
    JOIN schools sc ON a.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE a.avg_writing_score > 499
      AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT writing_rank, sname, CharterNum, avg_writing_score
FROM ranked
ORDER BY writing_rank;

    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT y.Segment,
           SUM(y.total_consumption) AS combined_total_consumption,
           COUNT(*) AS customer_count
    FROM czk_yearly y
    JOIN min_cons m
      ON y.Segment = m.Segment AND y.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY y.Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           combined_total_consumption * 1.0 / customer_count AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,

WITH segment_consumption AS (

    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
percentage_changes AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013 AS percentage_increase
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM percentage_changes ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT percentage_increase FROM percentage_changes ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_percentage,
    (SELECT Segment FROM percentage_changes ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT percentage_increase FROM percentage_changes ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_percentage;

WITH euro_customers AS (

euro_products AS (

    FROM transactions_1k t

)
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description

WITH jan_transactions AS (

),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT TransactionID, SUM(Price) AS TotalPrice
    FROM jan_transactions

)
SELECT AVG(TotalPrice) AS average_total_price
FROM transaction_totals;

WITH eur_customers AS (

    WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
),
high_consumption_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Consumption > 1000
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM eur_customers e
JOIN high_consumption_customers h ON e.CustomerID = h.CustomerID;

WITH cze_stations AS (

),
cze_product_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.ProductID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN cze_stations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM products p
JOIN cze_product_ids c ON p.ProductID = c.ProductID;

SELECT DISTINCT Time
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE GasStationID IN (
    SELECT GasStationID
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE ChainID = 11
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Price > 1000
  AND GasStationID IN (
      SELECT GasStationID
      FROM gasstations
      WHERE Country = 'CZE'
  );

WITH czech_stations AS (
    SELECT GasStationID
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE Country = 'CZE'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN czech_stations c ON t.GasStationID = c.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date > '2012-01-01';

WITH cze_stations AS (
    SELECT GasStationID
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE Country = 'CZE'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT t.TransactionID, SUM(t.Price) AS TotalPrice
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN cze_stations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
    GROUP BY t.TransactionID
)
SELECT AVG(TotalPrice) AS average_total_price
FROM transaction_totals;

WITH euro_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'EUR'
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT t.CustomerID, SUM(t.Price) AS total_price
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN euro_customers e ON t.CustomerID = e.CustomerID
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
)
SELECT AVG(total_price) AS avg_total_price
FROM customer_totals;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS total_paid
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT CustomerID
FROM totals
WHERE total_paid = (SELECT MAX(total_paid) FROM totals);

WITH earliest_tx AS (
    SELECT GasStationID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
    ORDER BY Time ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN earliest_tx e ON g.GasStationID = e.GasStationID;

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
WHERE c.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT t.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.Time = '16:25:00' AND t.Date = '2012-08-24'
);

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-23' AND Time = '21:20:00'
)
SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM target_customer LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.Time < '13:00:00'
  AND c.Currency = 'CZK';

SELECT DISTINCT c.Segment
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = (SELECT MIN(Date) FROM transactions_1k);

SELECT Country
FROM gasstations
WHERE GasStationID = (
    SELECT GasStationID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-24' AND Time = '12:42:00'
);

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-24' AND Price = 124.05
)
SELECT ym.Date, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS Expense
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN target_customer tc ON ym.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date = '201201'
GROUP BY ym.Date;

WITH cze_stations AS (
  SELECT GasStationID
  FROM gasstations
  WHERE Country = 'CZE'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN cze_stations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00';

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Consumption = 214582.17
      AND Date LIKE '%201306%'
)
SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN target_customer t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID;

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.CardID = 667467;

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
WHERE c.CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-24' AND Price = 548.4
);

WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS total_customers
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
),
eur_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS eur_count
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND t.Date = '2012-08-25'
)
SELECT 100.0 * e.eur_count / a.total_customers AS eur_percentage
FROM eur_customers e
CROSS JOIN all_customers a;

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
),
consumption_by_year AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM target_customer)
      AND (Date LIKE '2012%' OR Date LIKE '2013%')
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) * 1.0 / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_by_year;

WITH station_revenues AS (
    SELECT GasStationID, SUM(Price) AS TotalRevenue
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY GasStationID
),
max_revenue AS (
    SELECT MAX(TotalRevenue) AS MaxTotalRevenue
    FROM station_revenues
)
SELECT sr.GasStationID, sr.TotalRevenue
FROM station_revenues sr
CROSS JOIN max_revenue mr
WHERE sr.TotalRevenue = mr.MaxTotalRevenue;

WITH premium_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE Segment = 'premium' AND Country = 'SVK'
),
total_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE Country = 'SVK'
)
SELECT 100.0 * premium_count.cnt / total_count.cnt AS premium_percentage
FROM premium_count, total_count;

WITH Total AS (
    SELECT SUM(Amount * Price) AS TotalSpent
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE CustomerID = 38508
),
January2012 AS (
    SELECT SUM(Price) AS JanSpent
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE CustomerID = 38508
      AND Date BETWEEN 20120101 AND 20120131
)
SELECT
    t.TotalSpent AS TotalAmountSpent,
    j.JanSpent   AS SpentJanuary2012
FROM Total t
CROSS JOIN January2012 j;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT p.ProductID,
           p.Description,
           SUM(t.Amount) AS TotalSalesAmount
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
    GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Description
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT Description
    FROM product_sales
    ORDER BY TotalSalesAmount DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT Description
FROM top_products;

WITH top_customer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           SUM(Price) AS total_price,
           SUM(Amount) AS total_amount
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    tc.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
    tc.total_price * 1.0 / tc.total_amount AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency AS Currency
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID;

WITH unit_prices AS (
    SELECT TransactionID, GasStationID, Price * 1.0 / Amount AS UnitPrice
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE ProductID = 2
),
max_price_tx AS (
    SELECT GasStationID
    FROM unit_prices
    ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT g.Country
FROM gasstations g
JOIN max_price_tx m ON g.GasStationID = m.GasStationID;

SELECT yearmonth.CustomerID, yearmonth.Consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE yearmonth.Date = '201208'
  AND yearmonth.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE ProductID = 5
      AND Price / Amount > 29.00
  );

WITH max_rating AS (
    SELECT MAX(overall_rating) AS max_overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN max_rating mr ON pa.overall_rating = mr.max_overall_rating;
SELECT player_name, height FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player);

SELECT pa.preferred_foot

WHERE pa.potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;

WITH rated_players AS (

)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id)

WITH MaxCrossing AS (

    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT player_api_id
FROM MaxCrossing
ORDER BY max_crossing DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH league_goals AS (
    SELECT league_id, SUM(home_team_goal + away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM Match
    WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY league_id
)
SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN league_goals G ON L.id = G.league_id
ORDER BY G.total_goals DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH home_losses AS (
    SELECT
        M.home_team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
    FROM Match M
    WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
    GROUP BY M.home_team_api_id
)
SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM home_losses HL
JOIN Team T ON T.team_api_id = HL.home_team_api_id
ORDER BY HL.losses ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH max_penalties AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(penalties) AS max_penalties

)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN max_penalties mp ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
ORDER BY mp.max_penalties DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH scotland_league AS (

    FROM League
    WHERE name = 'Scotland Premier League'
),
away_wins AS (
    SELECT m.away_team_api_id,
           COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM Match m
    WHERE m.league_id = (SELECT id FROM scotland_league)
      AND m.season = '2009/2010'
      AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
    GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM away_wins aw
JOIN Team t ON aw.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
ORDER BY aw.win_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH team_speed AS (

           t.team_long_name,
           MAX(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS max_buildUpPlaySpeed

    GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
)
SELECT ts.team_long_name,
       ts.max_buildUpPlaySpeed AS buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM team_speed ts
ORDER BY ts.max_buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

WITH draw_counts AS (
  SELECT league_id, COUNT(*) AS draw_count
  FROM Match
  WHERE season = '2015/2016'
    AND home_team_goal = away_team_goal
  GROUP BY league_id
)
SELECT League.name
FROM League

ORDER BY draw_counts.draw_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH FastPlayers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE sprint_speed >= 97

      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', date) AS INTEGER) <= 2015
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_api_id,

SELECT L.name AS league_name, COUNT(*) AS match_count

ORDER BY match_count DESC

WITH filtered_players AS (

height_sum AS (

player_count AS (

SELECT height_sum.total_height / player_count.cnt AS average_height

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id

WITH team_attr AS (

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id

WITH avg_passing AS (

    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'

)
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name

CROSS JOIN avg_passing A

  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > A.avg_buildUpPlayPassing;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN p.player_api_id END)

        2
    ) AS left_foot_percentage

WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992;

WITH league_goals AS (

           SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM League l
    JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id
    GROUP BY l.name
)
SELECT league_name, total_goals

ORDER BY total_goals ASC

SELECT SUM(long_shots) / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots

    WHERE player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'

WITH avg_heading AS (
    SELECT
        P.player_name,
        SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) * 1.0 / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_heading_accuracy
    FROM Player P
    JOIN Player_Attributes PA
        ON PA.player_fifa_api_id = P.player_fifa_api_id
    WHERE P.height > 180
    GROUP BY P.player_fifa_api_id, P.player_name
)
SELECT player_name

ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, chanceCreationPassing
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
      AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
),
avg_cp AS (
    SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) AS avg_chance_passing
    FROM filtered
)
SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN filtered F ON T.team_api_id = F.team_api_id
CROSS JOIN avg_cp A
WHERE F.chanceCreationPassing < A.avg_chance_passing
ORDER BY F.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

WITH home_avg AS (
    SELECT l.name AS league_name,
           SUM(m.home_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS avg_home_goals
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
    GROUP BY l.id, l.name
),
away_avg AS (
    SELECT l.name AS league_name,
           SUM(m.away_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS avg_away_goals
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
    GROUP BY l.id, l.name
)
SELECT h.league_name
FROM home_avg h
JOIN away_avg a ON h.league_name = a.league_name
WHERE h.avg_home_goals > a.avg_away_goals;
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) = '1970' AND SUBSTR(birthday, 6, 2) = '10';

SELECT attacking_work_rate

WHERE player_api_id = (

WITH ado_den_haag AS (

    WHERE team_long_name = 'ADO Den Haag'
)
SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPositioningClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN ado_den_haag adh ON ta.team_api_id = adh.team_api_id;

SELECT pa.heading_accuracy

WHERE p.player_api_id = (

    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
)

SELECT overall_rating

WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas')

WITH league_cte AS (

    WHERE name = 'Scotland Premier League'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match
JOIN league_cte ON Match.league_id = league_cte.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016';

WITH youngest AS (

    ORDER BY birthday DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT pa.preferred_foot

JOIN youngest y ON pa.player_api_id = y.player_api_id

WITH max_potential AS (
    SELECT MAX(potential) AS max_potential
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.potential = (SELECT max_potential FROM max_potential);

WITH light_players AS (

),
player_feet AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_api_id, pa.preferred_foot

)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pf.player_api_id) AS num_left_footed_players

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name

WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky';

SELECT p.birthday

WHERE pa.overall_rating = (

WITH netherlands AS (

    FROM Country
    WHERE name = 'Netherlands'
)
SELECT L.name

JOIN netherlands N ON L.country_id = N.id;

WITH poland AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM Country
    WHERE name = 'Poland'
),
poland_matches AS (
    SELECT m.id, m.home_team_goal
    FROM Match m
    JOIN poland p ON m.country_id = p.id
    WHERE m.season = '2010/2011'
)
SELECT SUM(home_team_goal) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM poland_matches;

WITH tallest AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, player_name
  FROM Player
  WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
),
shortest AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, player_name
  FROM Player
  WHERE height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player)
),
tallest_avg AS (
  SELECT t.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
  FROM tallest t
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = t.player_api_id
  GROUP BY t.player_name
),
shortest_avg AS (
  SELECT s.player_name, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
  FROM shortest s
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = s.player_api_id
  GROUP BY s.player_name
)
SELECT player_name, avg_finishing
FROM (
  SELECT player_name, avg_finishing FROM tallest_avg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_name, avg_finishing FROM shortest_avg
) AS combined
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) > 1990;

WITH fast_teams AS (

SELECT DISTINCT Team.team_long_name

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name

SELECT SUM(pa.overall_rating) / COUNT(pa.id) AS average_overall_rating

WITH target_team AS (

    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed = 31

)
SELECT t.team_short_name
FROM Team t
JOIN target_team tt ON t.team_api_id = tt.team_api_id;

SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id = (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Doran'
);

WITH league AS (
  SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match 
WHERE league_id = (SELECT id FROM league) 
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
WHERE T.team_api_id IN (
    SELECT M.home_team_api_id
    FROM Match AS M
    WHERE M.home_team_goal = 10
);

WITH max_balance AS (
    SELECT MAX(balance) AS max_balance
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE potential = 61
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
CROSS JOIN max_balance mb
WHERE pa.potential = 61
  AND pa.balance = mb.max_balance;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END)
  -
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.id ELSE NULL END) AS difference
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye');
SELECT team_long_name FROM Team WHERE team_short_name = 'GEN';

WITH birthdays AS (
    SELECT player_name, birthday
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT player_name, birthday
    FROM Player
    WHERE player_name = 'Abdelaziz Barrada'
)
SELECT player_name, birthday
FROM birthdays
ORDER BY birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH left_footed_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN left_footed_players lfp ON pa.player_api_id = lfp.player_api_id
WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'low';
SELECT name FROM Country WHERE id = (SELECT country_id FROM League WHERE name = 'Belgium Jupiler League');
